headline: China Grants Autonomous Driving Permits to Xpeng and VW Venture
summary: China granted new autonomous-driving permissions to EV maker Xpeng and a Volkswagen joint venture, intensifying competition in the driverless transport sector.
why: Autonomous driving commercialisation is a critical battleground for traditional automakers and electric vehicle startups seeking regulatory approval in key markets.

impacts.name: XPeng Inc.
impacts.why: New operational permits allow the company to expand commercial demonstration of its driverless technology.
